method: Pinned source and immutable Phase 02 AST blob read directly. Resolve filter IDs to exact AST node. Ranges use original AST coordinates; source lexical tagging uses JS line slicing (non-ASCII byte/character offsets may differ); condition focus is AST preorder child for If/While/IfExp, otherwise explicit control span. Load shapes and operators are metadata; range links do not prove semantic equivalence. All branches retain outcome labels. No direct lexical signal does not exclude indirect time dependence.
